description.value: Beaucoup Bakery & Café is an award-winning French pastry destination in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, celebrated for delicate viennoiseries and East-West fusion creations such as the Peking Duck Croissant and Golden Mochi Croissant. Opened in 2012 and now co-owned by pastry chef Betty Hung and her brother Jacky, it has earned recognition from Lonely Planet, Forbes Travel Guide, and USA Today. Cyclists stopping here can expect espresso-based beverages, savoury seasonal sandwiches, and a rotating menu of baked goods.
